name: codex-harnessdock
description: HarnessDock for Codex is an unofficial third-party checkout-owned Claude Code Agent runtime with bounded leaf and Opus/Fable native-team delegation, durable roots, complete completion delivery, native message history, interruption, and exact-session follow-up; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

interface.shortDescription: Experimental durable local Claude Agents for Codex
interface.longDescription: Experimentally run the host Claude Code CLI through a checkout-owned Agent runtime with bounded leaf/Fable delegation, durable messages, bounded progress, complete completion delivery, fixed Agent-turn joins and all-settled barriers, recent native message history, interruption, exact-session continuation, and terminal-parity execution.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-harnessdock:spawn-agent with mcp__codex_harnessdock__spawn_agent to create an Experimental named Claude Agent asynchronously
Use $codex-harnessdock:followup-task with mcp__codex_harnessdock__followup_task to continue a Claude Agent
Use $codex-harnessdock:list-agents with mcp__codex_harnessdock__list_agents to inspect local Claude Agent work
Use $codex-harnessdock:wait-agent with mcp__codex_harnessdock__wait_agent for one exact Agent turn or a fixed all-settled barrier when the dependency set is known
Use $codex-harnessdock:read-agent-messages with mcp__codex_harnessdock__read_agent_messages to retrieve an earlier native Claude message without activating the Agent
